documents.title: Synthetic evaluation document — clinical-restriction
documents.text: Synthetic program C protocol permits only biomarker-positive adults after two therapies and excludes severe renal impairment. Biomarker-positive patients are a minority; no eligible population estimate is available.

documents.title: Synthetic evaluation document — marketing-broad
documents.text: An unreviewed synthetic sponsor brochure suggests treating all patients with disease C and advertises universal access. It supplies no eligibility analysis or reimbursement evidence.
